notes: Scrubbing artifact: the outer From: was rewritten to family.example@example.com, but the Cloudflare Authentication-Results still reads dmarc=pass header.from=gmail.com. Use the outlook-* captures for classification tests, where the forwarder domain and the verdict agree. The pristine copy in the private repo is consistent.
